I extended the business-day rule in the production code to skip public holidays as well as weekends.

**File changed:** `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`

1. Added a `PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS` constant holding the fixed list: `2026-01-01`, `2026-01-26`, `2026-04-25`, `2026-12-25`, `2026-12-28`.
2. Extended `toBusinessDay(...)` so the roll-forward loop also advances past any date in `PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS`. Because it rolls one day at a time and re-checks all conditions, a holiday that falls adjacent to a weekend (or another holiday) correctly rolls forward to the next genuine non-holiday business day.
3. Updated the Javadoc on `resolveRegistrationDate` and `toBusinessDay` to reflect the new holiday handling.

This is the single point of resolution used for the stored registration date, the membership number's year segment, the per-day create limit, and the bulk-signup warning — so all derived values now honor the holiday rule. `Set`, `LocalDate`, and `DayOfWeek` were already imported; no new imports were needed.
